verdict.rationale: Zapier's core product is trigger-action workflow automation, which inherently supports recurring jobs (e.g., polling triggers per zapier-docs-3), so the axis clearly applies to this product category. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a 'Schedule' trigger or shows an AI-native user (via MCP or SDK) configuring a recurring/cron-style workflow — the MCP evidence focuses on one-off, prompt-driven actions rather than scheduled recurring jobs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a schedule/cron trigger, and evidence that an AI agent can set up or manage recurring workflows via MCP or SDK.
